intent.oneSentence: A compact fire charge releases, travels right across 140 pixels in 0.25 seconds, and bursts at its arrival point with short scintillating sparks.
intent.firstRead: Fast directional fire dash followed by one local arrival burst.
intent.mustNotReadAs: An articulated phoenix, a newly improved flame body, or an automatically approved finished attack.
intent.useContext: Opt-in Studio creation starter at native 384×256, dark background, 30 fps; an editable example of existing generation capability.

readability.primaryShape: Existing single directional fire body and its trailing ribbon, followed by the existing terminal burst.
readability.focalPoint: The moving head, then the fixed destination at local x=70,y=-16.
readability.depthAndOverlap: Source-bound orange body with detached short sparks; no new depth renderer.
readability.contrast: Existing orange body, warm-white brief sparks and unchanged core lighting on dark background.
readability.secondaryDetailBudget: Existing default total 410 spark births: flight 240 and response 170, sharing 24 lit births. No density or light increase.

mechanics.driver: The existing generated dash trajectory drives the moving source.
mechanics.weightAndMaterial: Stylized fire, not rigid mass, a fluid simulation or a creature.
mechanics.causalChain: Release at 0.28 seconds, arrival and burst at 0.53 seconds, no response before arrival, then sparks cool and disappear.
mechanics.endingRule: Existing finite response clears by 1.78 seconds; no loop or hidden duration crop.
mechanics.exaggerationAndLimits: This starter only exposes an existing short-spark recipe. The long orange ribbon and lumpy terminal form remain; native still review does not certify full-speed motion.

phases.name: preparation
phases.cause: Prepare the finite source before release.
phases.visibleCue: Existing charge becomes visible at the left source.

phases.name: action
phases.cause: The stored dash travel plan moves the source.
phases.visibleCue: The existing head and trailing body advance right with detached short sparks.

phases.name: response
phases.action: Emit one local burst and response sparks.
phases.cause: The source reaches the shared arrival point.
phases.visibleCue: Existing burst begins at the destination, not before arrival.

phases.name: ending
phases.action: Dissipate the existing response and sparks.
phases.visibleCue: Remaining particles cool and fade to an empty final frame.

references.observed: Existing tested dash→burst short-spark renderer and default 410/24 shared budget.
references.application: Expose this fixed recipe through one additional Studio button.
references.limits: No renderer changes, new body quality claim, full-speed playback judgment or user approval.
